## TL;DR

Ran a focused headless Playwright QA pass against an auth-less server started from a detached scratch worktree. The work queue loaded, the New task panel opened at desktop and mobile widths, empty freeform submission was disabled, the Manual form exposed the expected core fields, and the existing task drawer opened without page errors. No reproducible defect appeared in the interactions completed. Screenshot selection updated the panel preview, but task creation did not visibly complete. Dependency editing remains unverified.

## Work and rationale

I first read the task specification and UI conventions, then used a detached worktree inside the assigned workspace as the server's source. This kept the preview board's writes and generated state away from the active task branch and complied with the request to use `just serve-noauth` from a scratch worktree. I built the UI and CLI in the scratch copy, launched the server on 127.0.0.1:7272, and connected using Playwright Chromium in headless mode only.

At 1280 × 900, `/work` loaded as RepoOS and rendered the task queue. Opening New task showed Freeform and Manual modes, a screenshot dropzone, story selection, and task creation actions. In Freeform mode, both Create task and Create draft were disabled while the description was empty, which provides clear prevention before submit. Switching to Manual displayed title, optional body, type, priority, area, and assignee fields. At 375 × 900, the root document's scroll width matched the viewport width, so the opened creation panel did not introduce horizontal overflow. I also opened task #1189's drawer and confirmed its summary and task workflow tabs rendered without browser page errors.

I attempted a disposable manual task creation in the scratch board after selecting a tiny PNG. The title and screenshot preview appeared, but clicking Create left the dialog open. I instrumented Playwright network responses and observed POST `/api/tasks` return HTTP 405 with `preview servers are read-only`; the UI displayed this message. The server was launched by `just serve-noauth`, which sets preview-child mode. The route guard intentionally permits only GET/HEAD in that mode, so this response explains the result. Screenshot upload persistence and dependency save cannot be tested through this server either. I removed the scratch worktree and temporary screenshots after the pass. The tracked change is the QA record in `docs/qa/2026-11-task-creation.md`.

## Approaches tried

I used the actual app route and UI in Playwright instead of relying on component-level tests or a static render. I captured the work queue and creation panel at both requested widths, inspected the dialog controls and disabled state, switched to Manual mode, and opened the task drawer. I collected page errors during navigation and drawer opening; none were observed. A first server start launched as a background shell process and was reaped before the browser connected. I then ran the server in a tracked terminal session, which provided a stable preview during inspection.

## Challenges and blockers

This pass did not verify a successful task create/update round trip, actual screenshot upload and persistence, or dependency selection and save. The task drawer was opened, but metadata was not edited. The Create attempt confirmed an intentional test-server write guard rather than a product defect; I did not add a speculative fix or regression test. Full create, upload persistence, and dependency-save verification remain outside the read-only server’s capabilities.

The task says to commit the QA note, while the active-turn checklist explicitly prohibits `git add` and commits and directs RepoOS to commit source and docs at handoff. I left the note uncommitted. The specified verification setup cannot exercise the remaining write flows. The task needs a writable test-server path or adjusted acceptance criteria before full CRUD verification can be handed off. I also did not modify `repoos.toml`.

## Key learnings

The empty Freeform state communicates validation by disabling both submission actions rather than waiting for a server error. The Manual form is available alongside the freeform path and exposes the expected task metadata controls. The creation panel stayed within the tested 375 px document width. These observations cover basic rendering and validation affordances, but the next QA pass should exercise a disposable successful submission, screenshot upload lifecycle, and dependency edit/save lifecycle before declaring those behaviors verified.
